title: Chipperfield MuckMate Electric Concrete / Cement Mixer
description_html:
Chipperfield MuckMate Electric Concrete / Cement Mixer

The Chipperfield Concrete Mixer is a robust and practical solution for mixing concrete, mortar, and other building materials for domestic and light trade applications. Featuring a generous 134-litre drum with a 100-litre mixing capacity, this mixer is powered by a reliable 370W double-insulated motor and operates from a standard 230V power supply.

Designed for ease of use, it incorporates a swivel stand and tipping mechanism for efficient unloading, while the sturdy chassis and ergonomic handles with comfort grips make manoeuvring simple. Large 10-inch wheels provide excellent portability around the worksite, making it an ideal choice for DIY enthusiasts, landscapers, and construction projects.

Replacement drums are also available when the drum no longer performs to their best. See the Chipperfield 100134O for more details.
